def find_k(n, first_half_incomes, last_month_income):
    # Check if the last half of the months have a profit
    if all(income > 0 for income in first_half_incomes):
        return n  # If all first half incomes are positive, any k will work

    # Try different values of k from 1 to n
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        # Check if the last k months are all profits
        if k <= len(first_half_incomes):
            if all(first_half_incomes[i] > 0 for i in range(n - k, n - k + (n // 2))):
                return k
        else:
            # Check if the last k months are all profits
            if all(last_month_income > 0 for _ in range(k)):
                return k

    # If no k satisfies the condition, return -1
    return -1

# Read input
n = int(input())
first_half_incomes = list(map(int, input().split()))
last_month_income = int(input())

# Find and print the result
print(find_k(n, first_half_incomes, last_month_income))
